title: The Mantis Shrimp
subtitle: It punches fast enough to boil the sea
script: Mantis shrimp. Fifty miles an hour, underwater. Fast enough to boil the water it swims in. Every punch fires a bubble that collapses in a flash of light, hotter than the surface of the sun. Animal one: impossible superpowers.

stat.label: strike speed underwater
stat.caption: The fastest punch in the ocean
